sentences.en: Sami did a quick scan of the room and saw Layla.
sentences.zh: 萨米快速扫视了一下房间，看到了莱拉。

sentences.en: With a 3D scanner it is possible to scan three-dimensional objects.
sentences.zh: 使用3D扫描仪可以对三维物体进行扫描。

sentences.en: My laser printer can also scan an image.
sentences.zh: 我的激光打印机也可以扫描图像。
